ItemID: 1; Title: Echo Dot (2nd Generation) - Smart speaker with Alexa - White; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am looking for practical computer accessories and have no current need for a voice assistant.
ItemID: 2; Title: Amazon Basics HDMI Cable, 18Gbps High-Speed, 4K@60Hz, 2160p, Ethernet Ready, 10 Foot, Black; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent display cable purchase was DVI, and I do not have an HDMI connection need right now.
ItemID: 3; Title: Fire TV Stick with Alexa Voice Remote, streaming media player - Previous Generation; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Nothing in my recent purchases suggests I need a streaming device.
ItemID: 4; Title: Seagate Backup Plus Portable 5TB External Hard Drive HDD – Red USB 3.0 for PC Laptop and Mac, 2 Months Adobe CC Photography (STDR5000103); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: USB connectivity fits my setup, but I have no clear need for additional storage right now.
ItemID: 5; Title: Cheetah Mounts APDAM3B Dual Articulating Arm TV Wall Mount Bracket for 20-65” TVs up to VESA 400 and 115lbs,Mounts on Studs up to 16”, Includes Twisted Veins 10’HDMI Cable and 6” 3-Axis Bubble Level; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My tablet mount purchase does not mean I need to mount a television.
ItemID: 6; Title: Amazon Fire TV - 1st Generation; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not currently shopping for TV streaming equipment.
ItemID: 7; Title: BlueRigger Micro HDMI to HDMI Cable (10 FT, 4K 60Hz, HDR, High Speed, Ethernet) - Compatible with GoPro Hero 7/6/5/4, Raspberry Pi 4, Sony A6000/A6300 Camera, Nikon B500, Lenovo Yoga 3 Pro, Yoga 710; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have not identified a device in my setup that needs a Micro HDMI cable.
ItemID: 8; Title: Panasonic ErgoFit Wired Earbuds, In-Ear Headphones with Microphone and Call Controller, Ergonomic Custom-Fit Earpieces (S/M/L), 3.5mm Jack for Phones and Laptops - RP-TCM125-A (Blue); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Wired audio accessories interest me, but I already bought a headset and would skip these without a replacement need.
ItemID: 9; Title: Fire TV Stick streaming device with Alexa built in, includes Alexa Voice Remote, HD, latest release; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Streaming features do not address my recent computer connectivity needs.
ItemID: 10; Title: TP-Link 5 Port Gigabit Ethernet Network Switch | Plug and Play | Desktop or Wall-Mount | Plastic Case Ethernet Splitter | Fanless | Traffic Optimization | Unmanaged (TL-SG1005D); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: After buying a USB Gigabit Ethernet adapter, I would choose this to expand wired connections; its simple setup appeals to me.
